name: Hero Roster
description: A five-card cast roster where selecting a card makes it travel and grow into a full dossier pane while the other four shrink into a two-by-two rail. Nothing fades out and back in — the cards that stay are the same elements, just smaller and somewhere else — and picking a thumbnail swaps the two mid-flight. The dossier's name, team, powers and copy ride on top of the morph rather than inside it, staggered in once the card has nearly landed.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Click any card to open its dossier, then pick a thumbnail to swap the two mid-flight
variations.description: A roster-to-dossier gallery built on shared-element transitions: one layoutId per card carries it between the thumbnail rail and the full pane, while the detail copy is staggered in on top of the morph.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the root wrapper's classes for call-site layout overrides.

features: Carries each card between the rail and the dossier pane on its own layoutId, so selecting one is a single element travelling and growing rather than two elements crossfading
Swaps two cards in one gesture — the new one grows into the pane as the old one shrinks back into the rail, passing each other mid-flight
Keeps the detail copy out of the morph: a shared layout animation cannot be steered, so name, team, powers and note ride on top and arrive staggered once the card has nearly landed
Paints every frame with background-size: cover so one URL serves both the pane and the thumbnail without an object-fit correction chasing a scaling box
Runs asymmetric springs — 0.52s with bounce on select, 0.4s flat on return — and drops content in 0.16s so nothing outlives the box it sits in

featureSections.title: Shared-Element Roster
featureSections.summary: One layoutId per card is what makes the roster and the dossier the same five objects in two arrangements.
points: Projects each card between grid cell and detail pane with layoutId, so position, size and border-radius interpolate in one spring
Uses AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" on the dossier so the rail reflows on frame one instead of waiting for the exit
Reflows the roster from a five-column grid to a two-by-two rail with `layout` on the container, not a remount
Keeps border-radius as an inline pixel value so Motion can undo the corner distortion the projection introduces

featureSections.title: Detail Layer
featureSections.summary: Everything readable arrives after the morph, on its own timing, because the morph itself cannot be choreographed.
points: Delays the caption plate to 0.08s and ladders the meta, name, alias and note from 0.1s to 0.17s so the dossier assembles rather than appearing
Staggers the power chips a further 30ms apart so the row reads left to right instead of landing as one block
Enters each line from 12px below through a 4px blur, and exits everything on a flat 0.16s spring
Drops the roster caption when the roster becomes a rail — it belongs to the browsing state, not to the card

featureSections.title: Photography & Theming
featureSections.summary: One image URL serves both sizes, and only the chrome that touches the theme's ground takes a token.
points: Re-crops with background-size: cover at every size, so the same photograph resolves at pane scale and at thumbnail scale
Holds a warm --hr-frame behind each photo, so a frame that is still loading reads as paper rather than as a hole
Inverts the 1px --hr-frame-edge hairline between themes — a black edge is invisible on a dark ground and a white one on a light ground
Leaves the dossier's caption plate white-on-dark in both themes: it sits on a photograph, and flipping it would put dark text on whatever the photo happens to be
